answer_2.quote: We use three kinds of metrics for evaluation. Exact match (EM) This metric is used to evaluate whether a predicted answer is completely the same as the ground truth. F1 score (F1) This metric measures the overlap of the predicted answer and the ground truth. Path overlap score (POS) When the model predicts an answer from a wrong tag but the text of the answer is identical to the ground truth, the exact match and F1 score will fail.
